Method of Attack: Spear phishing campaign delivering a RATVERMIN backdoor as a second-stage payload via a Powershell script
Use of malicious LNK files disguised as PDF and Microsoft Word icons to trick targets into running Powershell dropper scripts

Backdoor collects and exfiltrates system information, logs keystrokes and clipboard data with encryption, allows remote commands including process control, audio/screenshots capture, malware updates, and file deletion
Attack Vector: Spear phishing emails with camouflaged LNK files and compressed archives (ZIP and 7z)
Indicators of Compromise: Emails designed to appear from UK defense manufacturer Armtrac
LNK files disguised with PDF extension and Microsoft Word document icon
